headline: Singapore semiconductor shares tumble following Wall Street tech sell-off
summary: Shares of AEM Holdings and other Singapore-listed chip suppliers fell following weaker revenue forecasts from US semiconductor manufacturer Intel.
why: Singapore serves as an international manufacturing and testing center for global semiconductor equipment supply chains.

impacts.name: AEM Holdings Ltd
impacts.why: Lower capital expenditure plans from major global chipmakers lower revenue outlooks for suppliers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Negative sales guidance from leading US microchip firms sparked selling across Asian component vendors.
